metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

review_method: All145 thumbnails,25 larger whole-frame samples,5 face samples; native A1 frames0/30/48 or A2 frame60. No continuous normal-speed assistant playback.
actual_motion: One slow-ish step closes initial wide stride byabout1.5-2s. Later slight stance shifts and a small side turn; not sustained walk-through.
identity_wardrobe_background: Recognizable face and open cream blazer/white crewtee/navy trousers/shoes/bag retained in reviewed frames. Window/bench/wall/floor broadly stable without gross architecture morph; exact camera/geometry pixel lock not certified.
interval_note: Final trial retains initial step/settle through2.25s; later standing/side posing excluded. Prompt compliance remains partial.
motion_prompt_compliance: partial; does not provide continuous ordinary-paced two-step crossing
